description: Defines the PerformanceTrackerReviewer entity class with properties, ORM mappings, and getter/setter methods for performance review reviewers in the HRM system.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the performance tracking system, with ORM mappings and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the reviewer record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the reviewer record.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Returns the Employee object representing the reviewer.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Sets the Employee object as the reviewer.

methods.name: setPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Associates a PerformanceTracker entity with this reviewer.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the reviewer was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the reviewer was added.
